title: Reagent bottle
description: One bottle on the reagent shelf. A bottle may stand for a reagent combination that is always used together (e.g. 'NaNO2 / H2SO4'). Conditions (temperature, light, equivalents) are NOT part of the bottle; they are set in the minigames and graded as part of the route.

id.description: Stable ASCII id used by reactions and questions.

label.description: Short text printed on the pixel bottle (Unicode subscripts OK).

name.description: Full name shown on the reagent card.

smiles.description: Only for reagents that contribute atoms to the product (CH3I, ethylene oxide, an alcohol partner...). Used by the validator to run reaction SMARTS with multiple reactants.

shelf.description: Which shelf the bottle lives on; shelves unlock by chapter mastery.

technique.description: Default minigame that runs when this bottle is used in a step.

equivOptions.description: Equivalents the pour gauge offers (e.g. [1, 2] for H2O2).

tempPresets.description: Dial stops the temperature minigame offers for this bottle.

lightToggle.description: Show the light/peroxide toggle for this bottle.

does.description: One line: what this tool does. Used by reagent-card mastery and the mentor.

doesNot.description: One line: what it leaves alone / cannot do.

trap.description: Why it is on the shelf as a decoy, if it is one.

aliases.description: Other labels the player might know (for the 'reagent_label_unknown' tag).

classes.description: Reagent classes a reaction step may refer to with a '#class' token (e.g. alkyl_halide_1 for CH3/1° halides, base_strong for NaH/Na).
